sample_unit: inputs (500 mammograms, 500 chest X-rays, 500 dermatology images, 500 medical questions)

links.outcome: Presence of medical disclaimers warning of possible inaccuracy in LLM and VLM outputs across model generations
links.effect: LLM disclaimer presence fell from 26.3% (2022) to 0.97% (2025); VLM disclaimer rates fell from 19.6% (2023) to 1.05%. By 2025 most models displayed no disclaimers.
links.quote: Disclaimer presence in LLM outputs dropped from 26.3% in 2022 to 0.97% in 2025, while VLM disclaimer rates declined from 19.6% in 2023 to 1.05%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the prevalence of safety guardrails (medical disclaimers) in generative LLM and VLM outputs across multiple model generations using medical images and patient search queries.
